name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Manager, Onboarding | Team Leadership, SaaS Implementation & Customer Onboarding at Scale
summary: Onboarding leader with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, including 2 years directly managing and developing a team of onboarding specialists at Wix (a team of 20, later 8), personally onboarding 25+ clients per month while holding 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets. Builds the operational and reporting infrastructure onboarding teams run on, CRM segmentation, lifecycle-stage frameworks, and performance dashboards, at Solenzo today. Comfortable coaching a team to a consistent, high-quality onboarding experience while partnering cross-functionally to keep customers moving toward value.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Design and deploy automated lifecycle sequences, onboarding workflows, and CRM architectures that activate, nurture, and retain high-value users at scale.
Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network, driving rapid adoption of marketing automation and reputation management solutions.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value to their own end customers.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Took on team lead responsibilities for the sales team in addition to individual account management, continuing people-leadership responsibility carried over from Wix.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20, later a team of 8, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led onboarding and launch operations as team lead and primary strategic contact, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.

Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training of new hires and developing sales training for tenured account executives.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Guided onboarding alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting workflow design and resolving technical challenges during setup.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct strategic guidance.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
